description: Various insights about the game for displaying in the web app.

dummyVersion.description: A dummy field to fix versioning.

game_data.description: Contains data about the game overall.
game_data.title: Game Data

highlights.description: A list of the noteworthy exchanges within the game.

items.description: a section of the video that stands out
items.title: Highlight

player_data.description: Each player's data over the whole game for the web app.  If the player's location is unknown, the value for that player will be null.

anyOf.description: Contains player-specific data over the whole game for the web app.
anyOf.title: Player Data

rallies.description: An ordered list of the rallies within a singles or doubles game. This structure can also represent a distinct session or drill.

end_ms.description: The end time of the rally (milliseconds).
end_ms.title: Video Milliseconds

players.description: The positional information for players during a rally.  If the player's location is unknown, the value for that player will be null.

ms_to_kitchen.description: How long it took this player to reach the kitchen in milliseconds. Omitted if they did not make it to the kitchen.

started_on_left_side.description: `true` if this player started on the left side

players.title: Rally Player Positions

shots.description: The sequence of shots during this rally.

start_ms.description: The start time of the rally (milliseconds).
start_ms.title: Video Milliseconds

winning_team.description: Which team won the rally (team 0 or 1)

session.description: Defines aspects of the session or game being played.
session.title: Session

version.description: a version string matching x.x.x where x represents one or more digits
version.title: Version

title: Insights
